subject: Invoice ingestion: privacy, PO mapping, portal vs email
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northwind-logistics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@northwind-logistics.com
Date: 2026-01-17T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Invoice submission & PO mapping (Northwind)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this — we are ready to onboard as a vendor and have a couple quick operational questions before we start sending invoices. Attached is a redacted sample invoice (northwind_sample_invoice.csv) so you can see our line structure. Two quick asks:

1) Portal vs email: which path should we prioritize? We prefer portal but need to know how steep the integration is for a team of 2 FTEs.
2) Privacy/retention: does Redwood store full invoice PDFs/CSVs or only extracted fields? We have customer PII on a small number of invoices and need confirmation of retention windows and access controls (who internally can view attachments).
3) PO matching: our POs are issued per-entity and sometimes multiple PO numbers appear on a single consolidated invoice. Do you support multi-PO linkage per invoice, or do you require one invoice per PO?

Appreciate any guidance and a short checklist we can follow. If easier, we can set up a brief call.

Thanks,
Ethan Cole
Procurement Manager
Northwind Logistics
attachments: northwind_sample_invoice.csv (csv, 12KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northwind-logistics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-01-17T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission & PO mapping (Northwind)

Hi Ethan — thanks for the sample and clear questions. Short answers up front, then a recommended onboarding checklist.

Portal vs email
- Recommendation: Portal-first for go-live (lower manual handling, automatic PO matching, and subject-token enforcement).
- Email fallback: we support an SMTP fallback for the first 8 weeks for ramp/edge cases. Email submissions require a subject token and specific filename pattern to auto-route.

Privacy & retention
- We store both the original attachment (encrypted at rest) and the extracted structured rows for processing.
- Access controls: attachments are only viewable by the Billing Ops team and named approvers. Audit logs are retained and available on request.
- Retention window: default archival of raw attachments is 90 days, structured rows retained for 7 years for accounting. If you require shorter retention for PII, we can discuss a tailored policy (enterprise add-on).

PO matching
- We support multiple PO mappings per invoice. Our ingestion accepts a PO array field or parses line-item PO columns. If you prefer, we can require PO per-line.

Onboarding checklist (recommended)
1) Complete and return attached onboarding form (redwood_onboarding_form.pdf).
2) Confirm expected monthly invoice count and avg line-items (we use this for queue sizing).
3) Decide portal (recommended) or email fallback; if email, confirm subject token and envelope pattern.
4) Send 5 sample invoices (redacted) via chosen path so we can validate parsing rules.

Attached is the onboarding form and a short sample CSV schema we prefer. If you want, I can book a 20-minute sync to walk the team through the portal UI and the PO mapping options.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partner Onboarding — Redwood Inference
redwood_inference.com
attachments: redwood_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf, 84KB); preferred_invoice_schema.csv (csv, 3KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northwind-logistics.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission & PO mapping (Northwind)

Thanks Hannah — echoing the checklist and adding ops constraints for this account. For Northwind specifically:
- Allow email fallback for first 12 weeks (we can shorten later).
- Require subject token: "NW-INVOICE-{vendor_id}" in subject to auto-route to the right ledger.
- We will not grant view access to attachments outside Billing Ops and Finance Approvers.
- For multi-PO invoices: set parser to prefer explicit PO column if present; otherwise, use line-item mapping rules (see sample row in schema).

Ethan — once you return the form, Ops will provision a sandbox portal tenant and send credentials. We will validate 5 samples and confirm edge-case handling (multi-currency, tax lines).

—Vanessa
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northwind-logistics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Hannah/Vanessa — thanks for the clear notes. We completed the onboarding form (attached) and will send five redacted invoices via the portal sandbox once you send the credentials. Two quick follow-ups before the sync:

1) Can you confirm the encryption-in-transit requirements for portal uploads? We need TLS 1.2+ and SFTP option for an automated push (preferred).
2) Will the portal preserve original filenames or rename on ingest? We rely on filename tokens for our internal reconciliation.

If both are OK, please send sandbox access and I can set a call for Friday 1/23 at 10am PT.

Thanks,
Ethan Cole
Procurement Manager
Northwind Logistics
